shortDescription: Argentina state-run energy producer YPF BCBA:YPDCB said on Thursday that its board had agreed to buy out BNR Power Investment's nearly-25% stake in electricity subsidiary YPF Luz to take full control of the unit.The deal is set to cost around $430 million, YPF added in a statement.
